questions: Did this swelling and bruising begin after any injury or blow to your head, face, or eyes?
Did it appear suddenly within the last 24 hours?
Have you had any loss or blurring of vision in either eye?
Is it painful to move either eye?
Do you have severe eye pain or a feeling of pressure behind either eye?
Have you had a severe or worsening headache?
Have you had fever or chills?
Have you noticed weakness, numbness, confusion, fainting, trouble speaking, or difficulty walking?
Have you vomited or lost consciousness?
Have you had clear watery fluid or blood coming from your nose or ears?
Have you recently had a sinus, facial, or dental infection?
Have you started any new medication or had a medication or cosmetic injection near your eyes?
Do you take blood thinners, aspirin, or medicines that affect blood clotting?
Do you have a bleeding disorder or bruise unusually easily?
Have you had similar swelling or bruising around your eyes before?
Is the swelling or bruising getting worse?
